name: Gnoll Paw
summary: Gnoll Paws reach Sentinel Hill as proof of a patrol against Westfall’s Riverpaw packs. The People's Militia offers bounties to help protect local farmsteads.

sections.title: Bounty of the Militia
sections.body: The People's Militia defends Westfall from Sentinel Hill. With the royal army absent and the crown seemingly blind to rural troubles, ordinary citizens and volunteers face outlaws, rogue mechanoids, and Riverpaw gnolls. Captain Danuvin offers bounties for proof that gnolls have been slain. Bringing back their paws shows that patrols have searched the scrublands instead of resting beneath the watchtower.

sections.title: A Coordinated Menace
sections.body: Riverpaw gnolls in Westfall forage across the plains, but militia observers have noticed signs of close coordination with Defias thieves based around the Deadmines. The packs terrorize farmsteads and prey on supply wagons, helping shield the bandits from local resistance. Bringing in gnoll paws helps keep the overland routes between Sentinel Hill and Elwynn Forest open.

faq.q: Why does Captain Danuvin want Gnoll Paws?
faq.answer: Captain Danuvin asks for Gnoll Paws as proof of a successful patrol across the Westfall plains. With few resources and no aid from the crown, the militia pays bounties when recruits bring evidence of slain gnolls.
The paws come from Riverpaw gnolls that prowl Westfall’s grasslands, hills, and abandoned farms.

faq.q: Are the gnolls acting alone in Westfall?
faq.answer: No. Captain Danuvin and the militia suspect Riverpaw gnolls work with bandits and thieves based around the Deadmines, threatening local farmsteads.

faq.q: Why isn't Stormwind dealing with the gnoll threat?
aliases: why does the militia fight gnolls
faq.answer: Stormwind has left Westfall largely to its own devices amid domestic turmoil and political paralysis. Local farmers and The People's Militia bear nearly all the work of defending the countryside.

angles.text: For Alliance champions, taking bounties from The People's Militia helps keep Stormwind's western breadbasket safe from roaming beasts and organized bandits.
As a hunter, you can track Riverpaw packs across Westfall’s open plains while helping secure rural outposts.
